source.license_note: Real upstream uber-go/zap optimization PR #1350; measured-speedup task.

task.summary: Speed up the zapcore JSON encoder's string-escaping path so it copies runs of safe characters in bulk instead of byte-by-byte, without changing the encoded output.
task.instructions: Optimize the zapcore package's JSON string encoding for speed WITHOUT changing behavior. The benchmark BenchmarkZapJSON measures it; existing tests must still pass.
task.acceptance_notes: Behavior preserved (go test passes); higher measured speedup is better. Do NOT edit any *_test.go.

code_fault.description: zapcore's safeAddString/safeAddByteString escape JSON strings one rune at a time, appending each safe byte individually instead of copying runs of unescaped characters in bulk.

ops_fault.description: The JSON encoder's string-escaping routines in zapcore/json_encoder.go walk each input rune and append safe bytes one at a time, so encoding string-heavy log entries spends extra time in per-byte buffer appends.
detection_keywords: per-byte append in JSON string escaping
slow JSON encoding of string-heavy entries
no bulk copy of unescaped runs

visible_context.issue_text: Encoding log entries with many or long string fields is slower than necessary because the JSON encoder escapes strings one rune at a time, appending safe bytes individually rather than copying contiguous unescaped runs in one shot.
visible_context.notes: Real upstream optimization PR; no fabricated profiling numbers.
